headline: Aggressive Interest Rate Policies Risk Pushing Australian Economy Toward Recession
summary: Rising unemployment, falling house prices, and plunging consumer confidence have heightened concerns that the Reserve Bank of Australia's aggressive interest rate policies could spark a recession.
why: Tight monetary policy impacts consumer spending, housing markets, and employment levels, creating cyclical risks for national economic output.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: High interest rates weigh heavily on consumer confidence, real estate valuations, and employment growth.
